name: application-comparison-stat-pair
title: Comparison Stat Pair
description: Two side-by-side metrics separated by a "vs" divider, with the winning side highlighted — the winner is determined by comparing the real numeric values, not hand-picked.
useWhen: Comparing exactly two related metrics head-to-head (this period vs last period, plan A vs plan B).
You want the "leading" side highlighted automatically based on which value is larger.
A simple two-up layout is clearer than a chart for just two numbers.
avoidWhen: You're comparing more than two values — use a bar chart, bullet-chart, or leaderboard-list instead.
There's no meaningful "winner" between the two values (e.g. two unrelated metrics) — use two separate stat-tiles instead.
You need trend history, not a single snapshot comparison — use big-number-delta-tile or charts instead.
responsiveBehavior: The two cards and divider sit in a single flex row; stack them vertically at narrow widths in your own layout if horizontal space is tight.
accessibility: The leading side is marked with both a colored border/background and a visible "Leading" text label, not color alone.
When both values are equal, neither side is highlighted — the comparison never fabricates a winner.
The "vs" divider is real text between the two cards, keeping the relationship explicit for screen readers reading in document order.

variants.title: Comparison stat pair
variants.description: This month (1,284, leading) vs last month (972) new-signups comparison, on a light surface.
